name: GABAergic interneuron
definition: Local-circuit or projecting GABAergic nonpyramidal neuron

name: Perisomatic-targeting interneuron
definition: Axon targets soma / proximal dendrites / AIS of principal cells

name: Axo-axonic (chandelier) cell
definition: Boutons in cartridges exclusively on axon initial segments; PV+; SATB1-

name: Basket cell, molecular subtype unresolved
definition: Perisomatic basket morphology with PV/CCK identity not established by the source label. Inherits only morphology-level claims

name: PV-expressing basket cell
definition: Fast-spiking PV+ basket cell; MGE-derived

name: CCK-expressing basket cell
definition: CCK+ CB1R+ basket cell; CGE-derived; asynchronous release

name: Dendrite-targeting interneuron
definition: Axon targets principal-cell dendrites

name: Bistratified cell
definition: PV+/SST+/NPY+; axon split between s.o. and s.r.; avoids s.l.m.

name: O-LM / HIPP family
definition: SST+ feedback interneurons with soma in s.o. (CA) or hilus (DG) and axon in the distal-dendrite termination zone of entorhinal input

name: Oriens lacunosum-moleculare cell
definition: Soma/dendrites in s.o./alveus; >90% of axon in s.l.m.

name: Hilar perforant-path-associated cell
definition: DG homolog of O-LM; soma/dendrites in hilus; axon in outer two-thirds of molecular layer

name: CCK dendrite-targeting interneuron
definition: CCK+ (typically CB1R+) cells whose axons co-align with specific excitatory afferents

name: Schaffer collateral-associated cell
definition: Axon in s.r. (and less s.o.); oblique and basal dendrites

name: Apical dendrite-innervating cell
definition: Like SCA but targets the main apical shaft

name: Perforant path-associated cell
definition: Axon in s.l.m. and across the fissure into the DG molecular layer

name: Mossy fiber-associated cell
definition: CA3 CCK+ cell associated with the mossy-fiber pathway; grouped with CCKBCs in Tricoire cluster 6

name: Hilar commissural-associational pathway-related cell
definition: DG cell targeting proximal granule-cell dendrites in the inner molecular layer; may equal DG CCKBC but the term may span several subtypes

name: Neurogliaform family
definition: NPY+ late-spiking cells with dense local axon and slow volume transmission

name: Neurogliaform cell
definition: Soma in s.l.m. (CA1) or outer molecular layer (DG); GABAA-slow + GABAB output

name: Ivy cell
definition: MGE-derived; soma near s.p.; axon on proximal oblique/basal dendrites; Reelin-

name: Trilaminar cell
definition: Listed as a major CA1 class in Fig. 1 without further description in the review

name: Dendrite-targeting, family unresolved
definition: Placeholder for named types whose family cannot be read from the review

name: Long-range / back-projecting interneuron
definition: Axon leaves the home subfield (e.g. CA1 back-projection to DG/CA3); Tricoire cluster 5

name: Interneuron-selective interneuron
definition: VIP and/or CR cells preferentially innervating other interneurons. No netlist population maps here

name: GABAergic, family unresolved
definition: No family assignment possible from the label or the review (e.g. MEC types)

name: Principal (glutamatergic) cell
definition: Used only as a postsynaptic target class in connectivity claims
